subject: Architecture deep-dive (Mar 11) - parking-lot questions
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Simon Choe <simon.choe@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 08 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Architecture deep-dive (Mar 11) - parking-lot questions

Hi Simon / Priya -

Thanks again for scheduling the architecture deep-dive on Wed Mar 11 at 10:00am PT. As promised, we collected a few "parking-lot" questions from the engineering and security teams to make sure we cover the most important bits in the session. Can you confirm whether you want us to circulate these as the pre-read, or if you'd prefer we treat some as live questions during the call?

Parking-lot questions (short):
- Data residency: which Acme regions will host production data for the pilot? Any regulatory constraints we should be aware of?
- KMS integration: will you use a customer-managed key (HSM/KMS) in the pilot or allow Redwood-managed keys?
- Latency profile: typical p95/p99 latency requirements for inference for the 1k qps planned test?
- Model variants: need to discuss allowed model families & quantization constraints for private deployment.
- Audit logs / retention: expected retention window for request/response logs and whether there are redaction requirements.

Attachments: I attached a first-pass architecture diagram and a short pre-read (below).

Acme pre-read: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C4dRedwood-Acme-PreRead

If these look reasonable, I can slot them into a 30-40 minute agenda (20 min run-through, 15 min Q&A, 5 min next steps).

Thanks -
Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Enterprise Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
dylan.brooks@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

--
Attachments: redwood-arch-diagram-v1.png (image/png), acme-pre-read.md (text/markdown)

From: Simon Choe <simon.choe@acmecloud.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmecloud.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 08 Mar 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Architecture deep-dive (Mar 11) - parking-lot questions

Thanks Dylan - this is super helpful. Quick answers / context from our side so you can prioritize the agenda: 

- Data residency: pilot will run in us-west-2 only. For the pilot we don't have multi-region requirements, but we may need eu-west-1 for the production rollout (TBD).
- KMS: we plan to use our customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS CMKs) for keys at rest. We can share our key policy ahead of time.
- Latency profile: target p95 <= 400ms for text-generation endpoints at the 1k qps burst profile; p99 is less critical but ideally < 1.2s.
- Model variants: we need to validate support for Llama2-70b and a smaller 13b family; quantization down to int8 is acceptable if quality tests pass.
- Audit logs: 90 days retention is fine for now; we will surface any redaction needs before the pilot starts.

I've attached a copy of our SOC2 summary and a short note on our KMS requirements.

Look forward to the session - happy to take the first 5-10 minutes for Acme context.

Simon
Simon Choe
Senior Engineering Manager | Acme Cloud
simon.choe@acmecloud.com

--
Attachments: SOC2-summary.pdf (application/pdf)
